summary: Equillium, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 (Other Events) on October 5, 2026, disclosing receipt of Human Research Ethics Committee approval and Therapeutic Goods Administration clearance in Australia under the Clinical Trial Notification scheme for a Phase 1 trial of EQ504. The randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, single-center study will assess safety, tolerability, PK, and PD of once-daily oral doses from 0.1 to 3.0 mg across single-ascending, multiple-ascending, and food-effect cohorts, with GI mucosal biopsies measuring CYP1A1. Dosing of healthy participants is expected to begin by early November 2026. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are present.
